svg.text: R4-02 · Payload adapter and supported retaining lug
N2 / R4 prototype · All dimensions mm · Orthographic edge projections (hidden edges included)
Datums: A = mounting/print reference face; B = left X reference; C = lateral Y reference. Numerical dimensions govern.
Print broad payload mounting face down (inverted from assembly). Lug opening bridges4.6mm; inspect the bridge roof.
Assemble countersunk payload bolts to the payload/test panel while the adapter is removed from the receiver.
Countersunk heads must be flush or recessed≤0.1mm; protruding heads interfere with proper interface seating.
R4 manufacturing definition · Dimensional prototype only · No material or flight qualification implied
